ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District; B3-1, Community Shopping District and C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 22-F
Map No. 22-G and Map No. 24-G in the area bound by:

      South Green Street; a line 88.5 feet north of and parallel to West 95th Street; the alley
      next east of and parallel to South Green Street; a line 150 feet south of and parallel to
      West 94th Street; South Halsted Street; a line 125 feet north of and parallel to West 95th
      Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Halsted Street; the alley next north of
      and parallel to West 95th Street; South Emerald Avenue; West 95th Street; South Halsted
      Street; a line 279 feet south of and parallel to West 95th Street; and the alley next west of
      and parallel to South Halsted Street; and West 95th Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                            ____________________________
                                                            Ronnie L. Mosley
                                                            Alderman, 21st Ward
